title: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season, WR De'Zhaun Stribling out around 10 weeks

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season, WR De'Zhaun Stribling out around 10 weeks
sources.description: Initial word on 49ers tight end Jake Tonges's knee injury was that it would keep him out for an extended period of time and head coach Kyle Shanahan provided an update on where things stand at a Wednesday press conference.
